title: Special Provisions for As-of-Right New Buildings With Manufacturing and Commercial Uses

blocks.html: New buildings containing manufacturing uses or commercial uses shall be allowed as-of-right, provided that:
blocks.plainText: New buildings containing manufacturing uses or commercial uses shall be allowed as-of-right, provided that:

blocks.html: (a)        the zoning lot shares a common side lot line with a manufacturing or commercial use;
blocks.plainText: (a) the zoning lot shares a common side lot line with a manufacturing or commercial use;

blocks.html: (b)        the frontage along the street line of the zoning lot shall not exceed 60 feet, but in no event shall the total area of such zoning lot exceed 7,800 square feet;
blocks.plainText: (b) the frontage along the street line of the zoning lot shall not exceed 60 feet, but in no event shall the total area of such zoning lot exceed 7,800 square feet;

blocks.html: (c)        the zoning lot is not located within a continuous frontage of vacant zoning lots whose aggregate length exceeds 60 feet;
blocks.plainText: (c) the zoning lot is not located within a continuous frontage of vacant zoning lots whose aggregate length exceeds 60 feet;

blocks.html: (d)        manufacturing uses shall be limited to those permitted within M1 Districts in Special Mixed Use Districts, as set forth in Section 123-20 (SPECIAL USE REGULATIONS), inclusive;
blocks.plainText: (d) manufacturing uses shall be limited to those permitted within M1 Districts in Special Mixed Use Districts, as set forth in Section 123-20 (SPECIAL USE REGULATIONS), inclusive;

blocks.html: (e)        commercial uses shall be limited to those permitted in a C2 District, except those listed under Use Group V, and shall be located on Neptune, Stillwell or Cropsey Avenues; and
blocks.plainText: (e) commercial uses shall be limited to those permitted in a C2 District, except those listed under Use Group V, and shall be located on Neptune, Stillwell or Cropsey Avenues; and

blocks.html: (f)        no residential uses occupy the zoning lot.
blocks.plainText: (f) no residential uses occupy the zoning lot.
